plan.title: Live RFQ with two vendor bids

steps.note: Start the RFQ event creation flow.
Use the title required for later identification.
Configure the event as an RFQ rather than the default auction.
Apply the first available RFQ pricing template.
Add the specified product with quantity 10.
Populate the RFQ pricing sheet so the event can be published.
Set the requested delivery location.
Verify the specified location was retained.
Commit a valid live bidding schedule.
Invite exactly two QA vendors for the two bids.
Publish the RFQ so vendors can submit quotes.
Confirm the event reached a published project page.
Have the first vendor submit a quote of 100 per unit.
Verify the first vendor’s quote was accepted.
Have the second distinct vendor submit a quote of 90 per unit.
Verify the second vendor’s quote was accepted.
Verify the buyer sees two direct vendor responses on the RFQ.
Verify the buyer response view contains the 100-per-unit bid.
Verify the buyer response view contains the 1,000 total for the 100 bid.
Verify the buyer response view contains the 90-per-unit bid.
Verify the buyer response view contains the 900 total for the 90 bid.
